# Korean Market Analysis (August 12, 2026)
**Market Position & Sentiment:**
KOSPI stands at 6,579.04 [market-analysis:^KS11], supported by broader US equity strength with SPX at 7,728.2 [market-analysis:^GSPC]. Fear & Greed sentiment remains neutral-positive at 61 [market-analysis:fear-greed], while VIX at 15.39 [market-analysis:^VIX] indicates low volatility.
**Macro Headwinds:**
CPI at 3.5% [market-analysis:macro.cpi] and Fed Rate at 3.63% [market-analysis:macro.fed-rate] create a moderately restrictive environment, while NFP contracted by -23K [market-analysis:macro.nfp-mom], signaling labor market softening.
**Supporting Drivers:**
Tech sector momentum continues with NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 revenue at $81.6B with 85% growth [news:NVIDIA], Super Micro forecasts upbeat revenue on data center adoption [news:Super Micro], and Cardinal Health issued rosy profit guidance [news:Cardinal Health]. WTI crude at $83.15/barrel [market-analysis:CL=F] and DXY at 99.841 [market-analysis:DX-Y.NYB] support commodity-linked Korean exporters.
**Watch:** Gold at $4,477.9/oz [market-analysis:GC=F] reflects CPI risk management; 10Y yield at 4.684% [market-analysis:^TNX] remains elevated.
